description: This file contains a set of shell functions and scripts designed for managing GitHub pull request workflows, including resolving repository URLs, verifying PR branches, setting up remotes, pushing commits via both git and GitHub GraphQL API, and handling fallback logic for permission issues during push operations.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the URL for pushing to the PR head repository, using environment variables set for PR metadata.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Uses GitHub's GraphQL API to create a commit on a fork's branch, including handling file diffs and large files.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Resolves the HTTPS URL for pushing to the PR head repository.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Verifies that the PR's head branch matches an expected branch name.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Configures the git remote 'prhead' with the push URL to the PR's head repository.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Resolves the commit SHA of the remote prhead branch, handling fallbacks if needed.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Main function to push the prepared branch head to the PR branch, with retry logic, permission handling, and verification.
